description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to managing ranges on a virtual ring, including single and multiple ranges, with functionality for range operations, division, and formatting.

classes.name: SingleRange
classes.description: Represents a contiguous range on a virtual ring with methods for range checking, merging, and formatting.

classes.name: RangeFactory
classes.description: Provides static methods and constants for creating and managing ring ranges, including full, empty, and divided ranges.

classes.name: GeneralMultiRange
classes.description: Represents a collection of multiple ranges, with methods for creating, overlapping detection, and formatting.

classes.name: EquallyDividedMultiRange
classes.description: Contains methods for dividing ranges into equal subranges.

methods.name: InRange
methods.description: Checks if a uint value is within the range.

methods.name: RangeSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of the range.

methods.name: RangePercentage
methods.description: Calculates the percentage of the ring covered by the range.

methods.name: CreateFullRange
methods.description: Creates a range covering the entire ring.

methods.name: CreateRange
methods.description: Creates a range between specified bounds.

methods.name: CreateRange (list overload)
methods.description: Creates a union of multiple ranges.

methods.name: GetEquallyDividedSubRange
methods.description: Divides a range into equal subranges and returns the specified subrange.
